content.text: Governing law is New York internal law, with exclusive jurisdiction in New York City courts (SDNY or NY state court) and no arbitration clause anywhere in the document.

input.quote: shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: The Agreement is governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, and disputes must be brought in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the SDNY or the New York state courts, plus waivers of venue objections and forum non conveniens. That matches the preferred position (New York law, exclusive New York courts). A search of the document returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk. The only immaterial variance is that venue is framed as the City of New York rather than New York County specifically, which is noted but not redlined.
